reportTitle: Clean Historical Risk Map & Satellite Place-Name Label Fix Final Report
declaration_1: Grey insufficient-evidence records were hidden from visualization only; the underlying historical dataset was not deleted or modified.
declaration_2: Historical activity represents documented past activity only and does not represent current hazard, prediction, or early warning.

datasetInformation.source: Geological Survey of India (GSI) National Landslide Susceptibility Mapping (NLSM) NER Cleaned Inventory v2

greyMarkerRenderingChange.strategy: Visual-only filtering boundary at renderedMarkers memoization in frontend/src/pages/RiskMap.jsx

thresholdsApplied.INSUFFICIENT: < 10 (Insufficient Historical Evidence - Hidden from Map Canvas)

greyMarkerRenderingChange.underlyingDataPreservation: All 10,236 catalog records remain loaded in memory and available for analysis/statistics. The total count displayed in the GIS toolbar status pill continues to reflect the complete catalog (10,236 records).

finalVisibleCategories.label: High Historical Landslide Activity
finalVisibleCategories.description: Dense cluster with >= 65 documented historical events within 10 km

finalVisibleCategories.label: Medium Historical Landslide Activity
finalVisibleCategories.description: Moderate cluster with 30 to 64 documented historical events within 10 km

finalVisibleCategories.label: Low Historical Landslide Activity
finalVisibleCategories.description: Documented past activity with 10 to 29 historical events within 10 km (never labelled as safe)

historicalLegend.conciseExplanation: Only locations with sufficient historical evidence are shown.
historicalLegend.disclaimer: Past activity only — NOT a current hazard, prediction, or early warning. Historical catalogue records provide contextual evidence and are not active hazards.

satelliteLabelImplementation.layerName: Esri World Boundaries and Places Reference
satelliteLabelImplementation.attribution: Tiles © Esri — Sources: Esri, HERE, Garmin, USGS, Intermap, INCREMENT P, NRCan, Esri Japan, METI, Esri China (Hong Kong), Esri Korea, Esri (Thailand), NGCC, (c) OpenStreetMap contributors, and the GIS User Community
layerHierarchy: 1. BOTTOM: Satellite Imagery (Esri World Imagery, tilePane, z-index 200)
2. ABOVE: Geographic Reference Labels (Esri Boundaries & Places, overlayPane, z-index 400)
3. ABOVE: Historical / Current Risk Markers (CircleMarkers, markerPane, z-index 600)
4. ABOVE: UI Controls / Popups (popupPane & HUD overlays, z-index 700+)

mapInteractionBehavior.labelClickIsolation: The satellite label tile layer is configured with pointer-events: none !important via .satellite-reference-layer CSS class, ensuring clicks pass directly to the map viewport.
mapInteractionBehavior.locationSelection: Map clicks register accurately on map coordinates without being blocked or hijacked by label tiles, and without triggering unwanted zoom, search, or pointer shifts.
mapInteractionBehavior.controlIsolation: Leaflet event isolation prevents clicks on controls, legends, badges, or popups from triggering map selection.

preservedProperties: Active risk data mode (Historical or Current)

searchVerification.functionality: AreaSearch component continues to query geocodingService, navigate map smoothly with flyTo, and position focus pin at searched coordinates (e.g. Guwahati).
searchVerification.basemapIndependence: Switching between Terrain and Satellite basemaps preserves the searched location pin and does not reset the search state.

fourModeBasemapCombinations.Terrain_Historical: OpenStreetMap Standard + GSI NER Historical Landslide Markers (Red/Yellow/Green only)
fourModeBasemapCombinations.Satellite_Historical: Esri World Imagery + Esri Boundaries & Places Reference Labels + GSI NER Historical Landslide Markers
fourModeBasemapCombinations.Terrain_Current: OpenStreetMap Standard + Active Real Risk Assessment Markers (or honest empty state)
fourModeBasemapCombinations.Satellite_Current: Esri World Imagery + Esri Boundaries & Places Reference Labels + Active Real Risk Assessment Markers (or honest empty state)

performanceResult.spatialGridClustering: O(N) spatial grid indexing executes in under 100ms for 10,000+ records
performanceResult.renderingAcceleration: preferCanvas enabled on MapContainer ensures smooth 60fps pan and zoom performance with 9,604 markers
performanceResult.memoization: Precomputed classifications and rendered markers avoid O(N²) recalculations on component re-renders

limitations: Satellite place-name labels depend on Esri ArcGIS Online Reference tile server connectivity.
Locations with < 10 historical events remain hidden from the visual display to maintain an uncluttered GIS presentation, but remain accessible in the raw inventory data.
